create_one_dim_tr_model: create a 1-D transition reward model from a Hydra config with observation and action shapes
load_hydra_cfg: load a Hydra configuration from a results directory path
create_replay_buffer: create a replay buffer from a config with optional trajectory collection and loading
train_model_and_save_model_and_data: train an MBRL model on replay buffer data and save the model and data to disk
rollout_agent_trajectories: rollout agent trajectories in a Gym environment and optionally store transitions in a replay buffer
